profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Summit Human Capital
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with proven ability to resolve ideas into action with ambition, communication, and continuous learning. Clarified with 15+ colleagues, peers, and clients on ideas and problems to deliver optimal solutions and applications on a weekly basis. Quickly adapted 5+ frameworks and libraries on the go that aligned with business requirements and customer satisfaction. Passionate about sharing quality code, and guiding colleagues and clients through problems and solutions. Eager to bring flexibility to complex applications that save man-hours to both customers and developers.

I have 5+ years of programming experience. I worked as a Java Developer for QA automation for Atos|Syntel to help State Streets deploy financial web applications over 30% faster and saved over $50,000 in a year. When I'm outside of work, I created software and web applications for small-median companies like Mariachi Guadalajara PR and NextGen Realty to organize and use their data efficiently. With Python, BeautifulSoup, Twilio, Flask, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Express, React, and MongoDB, I was able to enhance their quality performances with customers by over 40% daily.

What I learned from working with companies in specific time frames is that I can be a source to push teams to be better than they once were. With empathic communication and open-mindedness, I can spark creativity where ideas are drawn and designed. With patience and accountability, I can be the initiative to learn and use new technologies while keeping things simple.

I have a dream that I can create a world of growth and love. It is a place where people are free to grow while developing meaningful connections and impacts. Seeing people compromising connections for work and growth, I am an inspiring programmer that can create bridges through problem-solving and technology to fulfill gaps.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description:
Cooperatively maintained and validated quality assurance of State Street’s web applications on financial risks and mutual funding through automation. In a team of 3, automated 700+ user acceptance tests and system cases on financial risks using Java, Selenium, and SQL for over 40,000+ customers and clients. Saved colleagues' time from manual testing by at least 90% and saved annual revenue by $50,000+.

► Consistently streamlined 100+ Java test scripts on 300+ user stories on navigating and modifying financial data, which maintained the UAT percentage process coverage by at least 95%.

► Earnestly mentored two colleagues to learn how POM designs are used in financial risk web applications, which outpaced delivering tested features from every 10 days to 5 days.

► Influenced HR and development team to save $1,500+ from using UFT by comparing how Selenium aligned with financial web applications and Java environments.

► Validated over 500+ test cases of matching financial data in 1 week by restructuring and simplifying tested code functions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Consulted into creating a Python web application that managed data and communication between real estate agents and leads for better customer relationship management and customer satisfaction.

► Initiated in creating a system that connects 50+ agents to 100+ leads daily through SMS and Voice by using Flask, Twilio, and multi-threading.

► Succeed in creating an automation tool that scraped 300+ leads emails daily, which saves agents 10+ hours from identifying and researching leads by using Beautiful Soup, IMAP/SMTP, and Crontab.

positions.title: Information Technology Assistant
positions.description: Analyzed and generated 20+ students' evaluations and reports a week through Oracle, Cognos, and Excel for Boston College facilities to improve customer satisfaction on classes, events, and housing.
